people.name: Saul
people.line: First king of Israel, anointed by Samuel

translations.web: One of the same place answered, “Who is their father?” Therefore it became a proverb, “Is Saul also among the prophets?”
translations.bsb: Then a man who lived there replied, “And who is their father?” So the saying became a proverb: “Is Saul also among the prophets?”
translations.kjv: And one of the same place answered and said, But who is their father? Therefore it became a proverb, Is Saul also among the prophets?
